http-request.regex:
^(GET|POST|HEAD) /[a-zA-Z0-9/._?=&%-]* HTTP/1\.1
Host: [a-z0-9.-]+
User-Agent: Mozilla/5\.0 \([a-zA-Z0-9;: .()/_-]+\)
Accept: [a-zA-Z0-9/*,;= .+-]+
Accept-Language: [a-z,;=0-9. -]+

$
http-request.description: HTTP/1.1 GET, POST, or HEAD request with common browser headers

http-response.regex:
^HTTP/1\.1 (200 OK|302 Found|404 Not Found)
Content-Type: [a-zA-Z0-9/;=. +-]+
Content-Length: [0-9]+
Server: [a-zA-Z0-9/. ()_-]+

[a-zA-Z0-9/+= 
-]*$
http-response.description: HTTP/1.1 200/302/404 response with headers and a body
